parameters: Stormrook is finally ours. We're in the belly of the beast - no turning back now!\! Move our base of operations here - Stormrook will be our springboard to assault Rimorgue City.
Brood of Kalytos the Red, the time is now!\! Dive onto Stormrook and destroy the invaders!
Didn't learn the first time, \n[8]?\! You'll pay a heavy price for your arrogance.
This is our last chance!!\! We are the elite, the proudest sons of Veridia... today we defend our homeland!!\! Knights of the 1st Army, push south and make \n[8] regret ever coming here!

War historians have always salivated at the idea of a decisive battle taking place here, at the Rimorgue River Valley.\! But rarely would any army would be in a position to oppose whoever controls it.\! Here we stand now, about to face the best of Casamir's army.\! Our truest test begins now...\| and to today's victor goes the fate of the world.
Stuck in a castle, just like before...\| Casamir, just to hunt you down, I'll find a third chance at life if I die today...
Not this time.\! \n[8], show them the power of the Nephilim Army.
